title: 第11章 洞房花烛夜第12章 太阴圣体
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: “秦关！给老子滚出来！”
很快，杨傲杀气腾腾的来到了正院。
听到有人喊他，秦关走了出来。
南柔听到是杨傲，一把掀开红盖头跑了出来，急忙提醒道：“关哥，他就是杨傲，你要小心啊！”
之前听说杨傲觉醒了真龙剑意后，南柔就提醒秦关，之前他杀了胡六，杨傲要是知道很有可能过来找他报仇，果不其然他来了。
“听说你是三境武夫，来，可敢与我一战？”杨傲抬起手中的长剑指向秦关。
“住手！”就在这时南云起突然来到了二人中间，他忙道：“傲儿莫要冲动…”
“姑夫，您这是要站在他那一边吗？”南云起话还未说完，杨傲突然打断了他。
“不是…”南云起一时不知该如何是好。
杨傲看向南云起冷冷道：“今日，南家有我没他，有他没我！”
此话一出全场震惊，言外之意，今日若是南家维护秦关，那他杨傲便离开南家。
二选一！
一个是刚刚觉醒真龙剑意的剑修，一个是三境武夫。
这二者放在一起，恐怕傻子都选觉醒真龙剑意的剑修。
一时间所有人的目光全都落在了南云起身上。
南云起面露难色，他不禁转头看向一身红袍的秦关与南柔，秦关面无表情一副风轻云淡，南柔则是一脸的惊慌。
当看到南柔那害怕的神情后，南云起心中突然涌出一股力量，若是连一个父亲都做不好，还做什么家主振兴家族，想到此他转过头看向杨傲：
“杨傲这里是南家，今日是我女儿与秦关的大婚之日，还由不得你放肆！”
南云起的话让在场人之一惊，他竟然选择了没有前途的武夫秦关！
放弃了觉醒真龙剑意的剑修？
现场众人看着南云起皆是默默摇头。
难怪南家只是一个三流小家族，这样的家主没有一点眼界格局。
“好，很好！”杨傲眸光一寒，手里的剑剧烈的颤抖起来。
“好你个南云起，亏我杨家一直扶持你，你就是这样对待我杨家人的，你真是个白眼狼，喂不熟的白眼狼！”
看到南云起选择站在秦关那边，杨红梅气的破口大骂，觉得杨家对他的好都喂了狗了。
“你给老夫闭嘴！”
南云起突然怒吼，他看向杨红梅，气的身体有些发抖，这个没有脑子不嫌事大的女人，他真是后悔娶了她。
沉默片刻，南云起似是下定了决心：
“往后，老夫会把这些年欠扬家的东西一一还清，从今天开始，你杨红梅被老夫休了，赶紧滚，赶紧滚！”
说到最后南云起像是疯了一样的怒吼，似是在用力的宣泄着心底压抑许久的憋闷屈辱。
现场所有人都被突然暴怒的南云起吓了一跳。
南顺达和南圆通二人则是心里说不出的高兴，没了杨家支持，他南云起什么也不是。
杨红梅直接愣住，她不明白南云起为什么会发那么大的火，难道就是因为在众人面前骂了他？
以前经常在外人面前在娘家人面前骂他数落他，他也没这么大反应啊？
还是说他根本就没爱过她，这些年和她在一起就是为了得到她杨家的扶持栽培…
这一刻杨红梅心乱如麻，心里有一种直觉，南云起没有吓唬她跟她开玩笑。
“呜呜…”实在是想不明白，杨红梅突然委屈的哭了起来。
“娘，您冷静点！”南乔急忙来到了杨红梅身旁。
“哭什么哭！我杨家可没有这样遇到事就喜欢哭的人！”
看到杨红梅在那里哭哭啼啼，杨傲冷冷嫌弃了一声，接着他手腕一翻，将剑斜指向地面，看向南云起：
“你若是敢拦我，休怪我连你一起杀！”
南云起眼神微眯：“正好，老夫也想试试这真龙剑意的威力。”
content_en:
"Qinguan! Get out of here!"
Soon, Yang Ao came to the main courtyard with murderous intent.
Hearing someone calling him, Qin Guan came out.
When Nan Rou heard that it was Yang Ao, she opened her red hijab and ran out, and hurriedly reminded: "Brother Guan, he is Yang Ao, you have to be careful!"
After hearing that Yang Ao had awakened the True Dragon Sword Intent, Nanrou reminded Qin Guan that he had killed Hu Liu before. If Yang Ao knew that he would probably come to seek revenge from him, he would come as expected.
"I heard that you are a martial artist in the third realm. Come on, do you dare to fight me?" Yang Ao raised the long sword in his hand and pointed at Qin Guan.
"Stop!" At this moment, Nan Yunqi suddenly came between the two of them, and he hurriedly said: "Ao'er, don't be impulsive..."
"Uncle, are you going to take his side?" Before Nan Yun could finish speaking, Yang Ao suddenly interrupted him.
"No..." Nan Yunqi didn't know what to do for a moment.
Yang Ao looked at Nan Yunqi and said coldly: "Today, the Nan family has me without him, and he without me!"
The whole audience was shocked when these words came out. The implication was that if the Nan family defended Qin Guan today, then Yang Ao would leave the Nan family.
Choose one!
One is a sword cultivator who has just awakened the True Dragon Sword Intent, and the other is a third-level martial artist.
Putting these two together, I am afraid that fools would choose the sword cultivator who awakened the True Dragon Sword Intent.
For a moment, everyone's eyes fell on Nan Yunqi.
Nan Yunqi looked troubled, and he couldn't help turning his head to look at Qin Guan and Nan Rou, who were all dressed in red robes. Qin Guan's face was expressionless and calm, while Nan Rou's face was panicked.
When he saw Nan Rou's frightened expression, Nan Yunqi suddenly felt a surge of strength in his heart. If he couldn't even be a father, how could he be the head of the family and revitalize the family? Thinking of this, he turned his head and looked at Yang Ao:
"Yang Ao, this is the Nan family. Today is the wedding day of my daughter and Qin Guan. You can't be so presumptuous!"
Nan Yunqi's words shocked everyone present. He actually chose Qinguan, a martial artist with no future!
A sword cultivator who gave up on awakening the True Dragon Sword Intent?
Everyone at the scene looked at Nan Yunqi and shook their heads silently.
No wonder the Nan family is just a third-rate small family, and the head of the family has no vision at all.
"Okay, very good!" Yang Ao's eyes turned cold, and the sword in his hand trembled violently.
"Well, you Nayunqi, thanks to my Yang family for always supporting you, this is how you treat my Yang family. You are really a white-eyed wolf, feeding unfamiliar white-eyed wolves!"
Seeing that Nan Yunqi chose to side with Qin Guan, Yang Hongmei cursed angrily, feeling that the Yang family's kindness to him was all in vain.
"Shut up, me!"
Nan Yunqi suddenly roared. He looked at Yang Hongmei, his body trembling with anger. He really regretted marrying this woman who had no brains and didn't take things too seriously.
After a moment of silence, Nan Yunqi seemed to have made up his mind:
"In the future, I will pay off all the things I have owed to the Yang family over the years. From today on, you, Yang Hongmei, have been divorced by me. Get out of here! Get out of here!"
At the end of the sentence, Nan Yunqi roared like crazy, as if he was vigorously venting the long-suppressed humiliation in his heart.
Everyone at the scene was startled by the sudden rage of Nan Yunqi.
Nan Shunda and Nan Yuantong were indescribably happy. Without the support of the Yang family, Nan Yunqi was nothing.
Yang Hongmei was stunned. She didn't understand why Nan Yunqi was so angry. Could it be because she scolded him in front of everyone?
I used to often scold him in front of outsiders and scold him in front of his parents' family, but he didn't react so much?
Or maybe he never loved her at all. He stayed with her all these years just to get support and cultivation from her Yang family...
At this moment, Yang Hongmei was in a state of confusion, and she had an intuition in her heart that Nan Yunqi did not scare her or joke with her.
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu" Yang Hongmei suddenly cried aggrievedly because she really couldn't understand.
"Mom, calm down!" Nan Qiao hurriedly came to Yang Hongmei's side.
"Why are you crying! There is no one in the Yang family who likes to cry when something happens!"
Seeing Yang Hongmei crying there, Yang Ao made a cold sound of disgust. Then he turned his wrist, pointed the sword diagonally at the ground, and looked at Nan Yunqi:
"If you dare to stop me, don't blame me for killing you too!"
Nan Yunqi narrowed his eyes slightly: "Just in time, I also want to try the power of this true dragon sword intention."
